title: ooRexx Unix Socket durable continuity ledger

records.rule: Current sealed candidate is oorexx_unix_socket_v0.6.zip SHA-256 aea3f193e910b216b051b046cc9ea695089e7ed67013a1a1a412d1324199e326.
unixsocket.cls owns Unix IPC semantics; Foreign Runtime owns libc binding, managed resource lifetime and ABI enforcement.
Stock socket.cls is AF_INET-shaped and must not be presented as supporting AF_UNIX merely by passing a family constant.
Qualified releases contain no Unix-socket-specific librxunixsocket.so; v0.3 native code is historical semantic oracle only.
UnixAddress distinguishes PATHNAME, ABSTRACT and UNNAMED; abstract names are binary-safe including embedded NUL; pathname names reject NUL.
Descriptors are owned resources; created/accepted/pair/received descriptors are CLOEXEC by default and transfers are explicit.
SCM_RIGHTS transfers capabilities. Raw received integers are converted to managed owners and originals closed.
MSG_CTRUNC or descriptor-limit overflow closes identifiable received FDs and fails with EMSGSIZE; never expose a partial capability set.
SO_PEERCRED and SCM_CREDENTIALS are kernel attribution evidence, not authorization decisions.
UnixPoll exposes semantic readiness; wouldBlock recognizes EAGAIN/EWOULDBLOCK.
sendAll refuses nonblocking descriptors to avoid ambiguous partial-prefix replay after EAGAIN.
chmod/chown pin verified socket inode with O_PATH|O_NOFOLLOW; unlink refuses non-sockets but still relies on controlled parent-directory authority.
Socket options are an explicit whitelist rather than a general setsockopt escape hatch.
Foreign Runtime v0.22.3 managed pointer graphs and binary buffer slices made safe msghdr binding possible and enabled migration away from the native shim.
Foreign Runtime executable ABI profile is authority for constants and aggregate layouts; mismatched/unqualified profile fails before dlopen.
Foreign Runtime v0.22.6 native aliases size_t/ssize_t/socklen_t/short/unsigned long own C implementation-width scalar typing; aggregate layout remains profile-qualified.
Only linux-x86_64-le-lp64 is currently aggregate-profile-qualified. Do not rename/copy it to claim AArch64 or another Unix.
v0.6 forcing validates 67 bridge constants, six struct layouts and 18 native-scalar declarations in addition to semantic regressions.
v0.6 qualification used ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 and Foreign Runtime v0.22.6.
Extend the smallest responsible layer: Unix semantics in unixsocket.cls, generic FFI capability in Foreign Runtime, ABI facts in qualified bridge profiles, OS-specific features behind explicit gates.

provenance.claim: Continuity ledger summarizes the current package architecture, surface, ABI boundary, dependency capabilities and platform claim.
